messages.message: Import '@heroui/react' outside the vocabulary tier — use the matching atom (vendor wrapped once); if missing, add an atom instead of importing vendor directly.
Prop `className` at sentence tier is a className backdoor (BLOCK-4) — name a real difference (new variant/composite) instead of accepting className.
Public house component prop `className` is forbidden. Parent layout owns placement; expose a semantic variant or use a named wrapper.

`cn(...)` outside the vocabulary tier (BLOCK-5) — treat this as a missing composite or missing variant; do not assemble classes here.

messages.message: `<StackV>` declares neither `principle` nor `explain` — a layer that says nothing about itself is a layer nobody can test, and nobody can safely delete either. State the seam it is (`principle`) and the reason it exists (`explain`).
Public house component prop `classNames` is forbidden. Parent layout owns placement; expose a semantic variant or use a named wrapper.

`contentClassName` lets a caller reach INSIDE this component and restyle a node it does not own — the one escape hatch that makes a component impossible to change, because every internal element becomes public surface. Whatever the caller is trying to say, say it as a NAMED prop instead: `nameClassName={isMe ? "text-accent" : undefined}` was really `isOwnRow`, and the component decides what own-row looks like.
